mu_name_from: Noria's object slot 35, which is the model index: every world but Lorencia runs its objects in one straight sequence, so type N is Object{N+1}.bmd and there is no friendlier name in the client than the number.
sheet_from: Data/Object4/*.OZJ and .OZT, from MuMain, decoded under an nr_ prefix. The prefix is load-bearing for the reason the ground's is: assets/textures is one flat pool for every world, and yellow_jewel.png was already taken by an item.
material_note:
flower2: green and gold leaf rosettes round a stem - the giant plants' own body, and the single commonest surface on the map.
flower10: a painted sunset - blue above, orange horizon, a sun and gold sparks. A light rather than a surface, and the only sheet in Noria that is a picture of a sky.
emitters_from: None: its glow is MU's BITMAP_LIGHT sprite on bone 3, drawn by game/world/ornaments.cpp (kNoriaGlows), which is what MU draws. It was a point light each until 2026-09-28, and 228 bluebells took the frame past its 255 lights; a sprite lights nothing, as MU's does not.
